title: Renewal Cohort Conversion Lab - Tracker (Mar 2028)
summary: Working tracker for cohort-based renewal experiments. Purpose: centralize contract dates, ARR exposure, experiment cohort tags (pilot / at-risk / expansion), calculated conversion probabilities, and prescriptive next steps for the QBR cycle. This is intentionally lightweight so AMs can copy rows into their account plans.

calc_notes: DaysToRenewal computed relative to last_modified date (2028-03-12). RenewalProbability is a blend of historical cohort conversion, recent engagement signals (last contact, usage trend), and risk flags from AMs. Probabilities are intentionally conservative for forecasting.
assumptions: ARR shown is ARR billed (net of discounts) at the time of last contract amend
Probability bands: >=85% = committed, 60-84% = likely, 40-59% = uncertain, <40% = at-risk
EscalationRisk annotated by AM based on technical blockers, exec exposure, or competitive motion
next_steps: Run cohort lift analysis by pilot tag to measure conversion delta for reserved-capacity offers (owner: Samir)
Prep a 1-pager play for 'short-term SLA + discount' use-case for deals with <60 days to renewal (owner: Lena)
Schedule weekly sync w/ sales ops to feed updated contract amendments into this sheet (owner: Ava)

Collect AM feedback on probability calibration after end-of-quarter QBRs and iterate forecasting rule
open_questions: Should we standardize NextAction picklist (e.g., Exec Review, Technical Deep-Dive, PO Confirmation) so downstream reporting can group activities? Need CS Ops signoff and a small migration plan.
quick_tips: When copying rows into QBR slides, use ARR-sorted view and annotate 'Net at-risk ARR' separately. For accounts tagged pilot, include a 2-slide summary: 1) metrics + gap; 2) proposed commitment path (price + SLA + timeline).
